value.rationale: It exactly quantifies how sampling correlation changes integrated-path error while every coordinate remains uniform and fixed-path unbiased: shared offset keeps an O(lambda^2) penalty, independence makes it O(lambda^2/n), complementary pairs eliminate it. Distinct compound-Poisson limits and total-variation bounds provide calibrated uncertainty benchmarks for jump-path quadrature; no general numerical method dominance is claimed.
